items.reason: A lower-strength retinol is a sensible starting point for softening the look of fine lines on sensitive-leaning skin.
Retinol makes daily sunscreen important, and a mineral SPF 50 is a gentle choice for sensitive skin.
A ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin comfortable and supports the look of a smooth barrier while you get used to retinol.

response.routine_note: Start with a pea-sized amount of retinol 2 nights a week after cleansing, then moisturizer, and build up slowly as your skin feels comfortable. Apply the mineral SPF every morning and reapply when outdoors.
